One of the best fps I've ever played. This thing is so damn frenetic I've to go lie down after playing for an hour. I LOVE IT.
Like Eternal and GTTOD had a baby with a 90's cyberpunk novel. I cannot put into words how fun and replayable this game is. It scales well in difficulty from top to bottom and runs buttery smooth. …

Sound mixing is broken. Dev doesn't seem interested in fixing. Suspect they patched the game with some odd loudness EQ settings and then introduced a channel mixer to negate all the complaints from people. …
无敌链锯腿上挥，血花四溅肉横飞 辗转腾挪似风雷，神挡杀神爱谁谁
比毁灭战士还爽，发明链锯腿的真是个天才，每一把武器的副模式都很有创意，发射微型导弹还竖个中指真是帅到爆炸，音乐有品風格化強，怪物图鉴本地化太幽默了，弱点：赶紧弄死
开枪之后，我根本不知道自己是否打中了敌人，除了打开伤害数字我没有其余方法确认攻击是否命中，枪口的光效和血腥效果阻止我观察敌人位置和弹幕；切枪有收益吗？ …
